entities.summary: Joakim Kemell is a Finnish professional ice hockey forward who is currently playing with the Nashville Predators of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was touted as one of the top Finnish prospects, and was drafted 17th overall by the Predators in 2022 NHL entry draft.
